instructionSteps.title: 1. Prerequisites
instructionSteps.description: Ensure you have the required access and configuration before connecting.

parameters.content:
## Prerequisites

- A Claroty xDome tenant with the public API enabled.
- An xDome API token (Bearer) with read access. Generate it in the xDome console under **Admin Settings > User Management**.
- Your xDome API root URL, for example `https://<region>.api.claroty.com`. The connector appends the `/api/v1/...` paths automatically - do not include a trailing slash or the `/api/v1` segment.
- Outbound network connectivity from the Microsoft Sentinel CCF service to your xDome API endpoint. If your xDome API restricts source IPs, allowlist the Microsoft Sentinel **Scuba** service tag.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Connect to Claroty xDome
instructionSteps.description: Add a connection with your xDome API root URL and Bearer token, then choose which data types to ingest (all are selected by default). Optionally provide a per-data-type filter and polling window.

parameters.content:
## Optional per-data-type filters

Leave a filter blank to ingest everything for that data type. To cut volume, paste a single xDome **filter_by** JSON object; it is combined (AND) with the incremental time window. Examples:

- **Alerts** - only some categories: `{"field":"category","operation":"in","value":["Threat","Segmentation"]}`
- **OT Events** - exclude scans: `{"field":"event_type","operation":"not_in","value":["Scan"]}`
- **Vulnerabilities** - high severity only: `{"field":"cvss_v3_score","operation":"greater_or_equal","value":7}`
- **Devices** - OT/Medical only: `{"field":"device_category","operation":"in","value":["OT","Medical"]}`
- **Audit Log** - authentication only: `{"field":"category","operation":"in","value":["Authentication"]}`

properties.displayName: Network Session ASIM filtering parser for Claroty xDome OT activity events
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dstipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dstportnumber:int=int(null),
    hostname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dvcaction:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string='*',
    disabled:bool=false
) {
    let src_or_any = set_union(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix, ipaddr_has_any_prefix);
    let dst_or_any = set_union(dstipaddr_has_any_prefix, ipaddr_has_any_prefix);
    ClarotyXDomeOTEvent_CL
    | where not(disabled)
        and (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
        and (array_length(dvcaction) == 0 or Mode has_any (dvcaction))
        and (isnull(dstportnumber) or DestPort == dstportnumber)
        and (array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0 or SourceDeviceName has_any (hostname_has_any) or DestDeviceName has_any (hostname_has_any))
        and (array_length(src_or_any) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIP, src_or_any))
        and (array_length(dst_or_any) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DestIP, dst_or_any))
    | extend
        EventOriginalType = EventType,
        EventOriginalUid = tostring(EventId),
        EventOriginalSubType = Mode,
        EventMessage = Description

The Claroty xDome CCF solution ingests Claroty xDome data into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) pull pattern - polling the xDome public API directly, with no agent, collector VM, or syslog forwarder required. A single API-polling data connector ingests seven data types into dedicated tables: Alerts, Device-Alert relations, OT Activity Events, Vulnerabilities, Device-Vulnerability relations, Device inventory, and Audit Log. Each data type supports an optional filter to control ingested volume. Connect once with your xDome API root URL and a Bearer API token.
